status: Local prototype implemented. Existing Codex ChatGPT account and real host inference verified. Fresh browser consent, GitHub authorization and composed OS runtime remain unverified.
preference: Browser sign-in using the ChatGPT plan; do not require an OpenAI API key

service_roles.GitHub: Repository sync, review and released update packages
service_roles.Codex: Local execution runtime for project editing, tests, approvals and saved threads
service_roles.OpenAI: Provides the online models through the authorized ChatGPT plan

initial_states.Project folder: Automatically selected OS root; build project in the host preview

authentication.route: Official Sign in with ChatGPT for open-source locally hosted clients
authentication.browser: System browser, such as Chrome or Edge; official authorization pages
authentication.eligibility: Eligible accounts and plan usage limits apply; verify after sign-in
authentication.credential_storage: Per user, outside the repository and distributable ISO; use a supported secure store or tightly restricted local storage
authentication.embedded_browser: Do not assume supported; prototype official system-browser flow first
authentication.device_code_fallback: Available through Codex CLI/app-server managed authentication where supported; test before relying on it on Validation OS

project_workflow: Automatically use the installed Validation OS root as the workspace; use this build project in the Windows host preview. Opening another project is optional.
Optionally connect a GitHub repository with an independently authorized GitHub integration.
Associate the absolute folder path and Git metadata with a saved local Codex thread ID.
Start and resume Codex work scoped to that folder; allowlist additional actions explicitly.
Save project files to disk, keep conversation history locally and use deliberate Git checkpoints.
On restart restore the selected folder and resume the saved thread; restart the runtime with refreshed OAuth tokens when required.

github.authentication: Separate browser/device OAuth authorization; ChatGPT sign-in does not authorize GitHub
github.registration: Register a GitHub integration before implementing its user authorization
github.automatic_review: Separate from device-local Codex; enable through the connected repository and Codex review settings
github.public_updates: Public release downloads may be unauthenticated; always verify publisher signatures before applying updates

constraints: ChatGPT sign-in does not import existing ChatGPT conversations or memories.
ChatGPT sign-in does not grant administrator control of Windows.
Codex app-server is currently experimental and not supported for production workloads.
Chrome, Edge, secure storage and the Codex runtime must each be tested against the composed Validation OS API surface.
Writable project and thread storage must survive reboots; do not store durable state only in a RAM boot volume.
Keep boot-time operating-system servicing independent of the AI suggestion loop and provide a tested recovery path.
